title: Firewall rule modal interface-label robustness
acceptance_criteria: Create Firewall Rule modal shows interface selectors with description-first labels where descriptions exist.
Edit Firewall Rule modal shows interface selectors with description-first labels where descriptions exist.
Underlying selected values remain canonical interface names for write operations.
Feature degrades safely to raw interface names when descriptions are unavailable.
Frontend validation gates pass (tsc, lint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke).
assumptions: Interface descriptions should be sourced from ethernet config and mapped onto the broader show-interface list where names match.
Rule APIs should continue receiving interface names only; labels are display-only.
Existing unrelated working tree changes remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added ethernet config description hydration and description-first labels for inbound/outbound interface selectors.
Executed frontend tsc/lint/build + runtime/browser smoke checks.
Manual verification pending on live firewall rule create/edit flows.
